game_title: Guess Until Right – Exit Light Ledge Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round, cave spiders strike the stone seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the stone seal from cave spiders in Exit Light Ledge: keep the guess_range meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: guess_range drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Exit Light Ledge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while guess_range > 0.
